subject: oop
question: Can an interface contain a constructor? Justify.
title: No Object, No Constructor
hook: Can an interface have a constructor? No.
answer: No, an interface cannot contain a constructor.
A constructor builds an object, and you can never create an object of an interface.
An interface has no instance fields to initialize: only public static final constants and abstract methods.
So there is nothing for a constructor to do; Java does not allow it and the compiler gives an error.
Memory trick: no object, no constructor.
